## About
We are a general contractor crew based on W Baseline Rd in Claremont. We do everything from a small handyman fix to a full kitchen and bathroom remodel.
A homeowner came to us after a stressful flooding situation at home. We handled the flooring, drywall, kitchen and bathroom, and kept them updated the whole way. That is how we like to work on every job, big or small.
We are rated 5 from 132 Google reviews, and we are glad our neighbors keep sending people our way.

## Services
- Kitchen and bathroom remodels: Full kitchen remodels and bathroom renovations, planned and built by our team.
- Flooring and drywall: New flooring and drywall work, including repairs after water damage.
- Fence rebuilds: We tear out and rebuild fences. A customer said the crew was fast, respectful and very clean.
- Handyman services: Smaller fixes and odd jobs around the house, done with attention to detail.
